findings.title: Locale test mocks accept missing keys
findings.context: Both mocks return scope.key for arbitrary keys. A missing locale key can render a passing sentinel instead of failing.
findings.impact: The active homepage and Primary tests can miss a renamed or missing message.
findings.recommendation: Use locale-backed lookup mocks that throw for missing or non-text values, and render each supported locale.
findings.disposition: Nonblocking. Runtime locale parity passes and the mock gap predates this candidate.
